name: gamez_zbd_reload_display_instances_recursive
description: GameZ_ZBD::ReloadDisplayInstancesRecursive reloads a node's display instance from the current ZBD stream and optionally recurses through children.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zClass/ZBD/DI-pool source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4557a0 validates node-index bounds checks, node-table seek/read, diagnostic return on node read failure, model3D section seek, old display-instance capture and clearing, indexed DI-pool reload, restoration on reload failure, successful replacement plus old-instance free, optional child recursion through listB, and success return 0.

The native reload-display smoke writes a two-node ZBD fixture, reloads root and child display instances through the public current-path wrapper, verifies recursive replacement, serialized display-instance fields, ref counts, DI-pool in-use count, and free-head exhaustion.
